title: Google Ads Performance Coach
tagline: Turn ad exports into a calculation workbook, measurement check, and prioritized action plan.
businessOutcomes: Make advertising performance easier to understand

businessProblem.summary: Small businesses usually have access to advertising reports but not the time or expertise to work out what is working, what is wasting money, and what should be changed first. The reports show numbers; they do not say which number matters this month, or whether the number can be trusted at all.
businessProblem.goodFitHeading: This is likely useful if you
goodFitIf: Spend time manually reviewing campaign reports
Are unsure whether conversion tracking is reliable
Receive reports but do not know which actions to prioritize
Want to better understand advertising performance before making changes

whatItDoes.summary: The workflow reads your exported advertising and website reports, does the arithmetic and the routine checks for you, and then explains what it found in plain language.
capabilities: Organize advertising cost, clicks, conversions, and related metrics
Identify campaigns or keywords that require investigation
Compare advertising results with GA4 website behavior
Produce a prioritized list of recommended next actions
whatItDoes.confidenceNote: Every finding is labelled so you can tell the difference between what the data shows and what the AI is guessing. Nothing here is a guaranteed outcome.

confidenceLevels.label: Confirmed finding
confidenceLevels.description: Supported directly by the numbers in the reports you uploaded.

confidenceLevels.label: Possible explanation
confidenceLevels.description: A plausible reason for what the data shows, which still needs to be investigated before you act on it.

confidenceLevels.label: Recommendation
confidenceLevels.description: A suggested next step. Review it yourself before changing any campaign.

howItWorks.note: The order matters. The totals, ratios, and rule-based checks are calculated first, so the numbers are the same every time you run it. The AI model only explains and prioritizes what those calculations already found — it is not asked to do the arithmetic. Any capable AI assistant can play that role; the workflow does not depend on one provider.

whatYouNeed.note: No integration or developer work is needed to try this. The reports are ordinary exports, and any AI assistant you already use is enough to run the manual version.

exampleOutput.disclaimer: Illustrative sample only. The numbers below are made up to show the format of the output. They are not from a real business and are not a benchmark.

findings.label: Confirmed finding
findings.finding: Campaign A spent $840 during the selected period but recorded no tracked conversions.
findings.whyItMatters: This campaign represents 18% of total spend. Before reducing the budget, confirm that conversion tracking is working correctly.
findings.nextAction: Review the campaign's search terms and landing page, then test the conversion event before changing bids or budget.

findings.label: Possible explanation
findings.finding: Google Ads reports 32 conversions for the period while GA4 reports 19 key events from the same campaigns.
findings.whyItMatters: The two systems count conversions differently, so a gap is normal — but a gap this size can also mean duplicate tags, a missing event, or a mismatched date range. Until it is explained, neither number should drive a budget decision.
findings.nextAction: Compare the date ranges and attribution settings first, then check whether each conversion action has a matching GA4 key event.

findings.label: Confirmed finding
findings.finding: The /offers landing page received 61% of ad traffic but has the lowest engagement rate of the pages in the report.
findings.whyItMatters: Most of the paid traffic is arriving on a page visitors leave quickly, which limits what any bidding change can achieve.
findings.nextAction: Check that the page matches what the ads promise, and confirm it loads correctly on a phone before spending more on the campaigns pointing to it.

manualApproach.effort: Beginner — no tools to set up
steps: Export the relevant Google Ads report
Upload both reports to an AI assistant
Ask it to separate confirmed findings from assumptions
Review the recommended actions before changing campaigns
manualApproach.note: A complete playbook with export instructions, prompts, templates, and checklists is available, including sample input files and a calculated workbook example.

automatedApproach.effort: Intermediate — requires setting up a small local tool
automatedApproach.summary: Once the manual version is producing useful answers, the same steps can be handled by a simple tool that runs on your own computer.
capabilities: Accept Google Ads and GA4 report uploads
Run repeatable quality and performance checks
automatedApproach.note: The first automated version works from uploaded CSV files, so no Google Ads API access or developer integration is required. This tool is not built yet.

summary: Review Google Ads and GA4 exports with an AI assistant that calculates the metrics, checks conversion tracking, and separates confirmed findings from hypotheses.
businessProblem: Small businesses often have ad data but cannot tell which numbers are trustworthy, whether conversions are configured correctly, or which issue should be investigated first. Generic AI analysis can confidently optimize the wrong metric when page views or other low-value events are configured as Primary conversions.
outcome: A repeatable audit package containing a calculated Excel workbook, measurement-readiness status, campaign and landing-page findings, and a short action plan with evidence and guardrails.
expectedOutcomes: Less time spent manually reconciling Google Ads and GA4 reports
Clear separation between confirmed findings and possible explanations
A prioritized list of safe verification steps and controlled tests
whoItsFor: Small-business owners, marketers, and consultants who can export Google Ads and GA4 reports but want a structured review before changing budgets, bidding, or landing pages.
aiInputs: Current and previous Google Ads campaign CSV files
Current and previous GA4 Traffic acquisition CSV files
Current and previous GA4 Landing page CSV files
Business context and definition of a qualified outcome
aiOutputs: Search-term and landing-page findings when supported
noCodeTools: File-capable ChatGPT with the Google Ads AI Audit Playbook
Google Ads and GA4 manual CSV exports
Excel or Google Sheets for reviewing the generated workbook
lowCodeTools: Google Apps Script or Python for standardized exports
n8n or Make for scheduled file collection
A reusable workbook-generation script with human review
customBuildStack: Google Ads API and Google Analytics Data API
Python data validation and formula-driven workbook generation
LLM structured-output layer for evidence-based findings
Secure report storage and action-log workflow
implementationSteps: Define the qualified business outcome and acceptable cost target
Export matching current and previous periods from Google Ads and GA4
Capture one conversion-actions screenshot with the required columns visible
Upload the files and run the workbook-generation prompt
Review the generated Dashboard, Calculated Metrics, Conversion Setup, and Read Me sheets
Run the evidence-based audit prompt using the workbook as the arithmetic source of truth
Approve only the smallest safe tests and record owners, due dates, and review dates
systemBehavior: Checks measurement readiness before evaluating campaign efficiency
Creates a new calculation workbook for each audit period
Labels findings as confirmed, possible explanation, or recommendation
Stops budget and bidding recommendations when meaningful tracking is unreliable
Documents missing files, filters, assumptions, and limitations
risks: A page view or other low-value event may be mistaken for a qualified outcome
GA4 All Users exports may be incorrectly treated as paid Google traffic
Google Ads and GA4 will not reconcile exactly because their measurement concepts differ
Small samples can produce unstable trends
Uploaded reports may contain sensitive business or customer information
AI-generated spreadsheets require arithmetic and formula review before decisions
